text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
And now, for the face of the past four<n>seasons! Our
Umamusume of the<n>Year...

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Holding a firm grip on the lead, she<n>astounded us
with a number of<n>spectacular getaways. Everyone,
give it up for Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Taiki Shuttle wasn't<n>able to achieve
her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But her overwhelming power and<n>speed have
certainly captivated the<n>hearts of many fans as the
fastest<n>sprinter around.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our first three years together have<n>passed by, just
like that...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for being so tardy! By the time I<n>realized it, my
feet were takin' me to<n>the racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I was so sure I'd get Umamusume of<n>the Year this
time around, but I guess<n>I went overboard with
everything!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, our time together has flown<n>right by. Just
as fast as me down the<n>track!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The two of us have accomplished so<n>much. My
family's pleased as punch<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Were you happy bein' by my side,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yay! I was hoping you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I might not've become Umamusume<n>of the Year
yet, but I ain't finished<n>trying!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep on runnin' and<n>making people
happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for everything, Trainer! I'm<n>lookin' forward
to what the future's<n>got in store for us!
